caption: The drawing depicts three views of an amber-brown glass bottle with a flattened, oval shape. The largest view, centered in the lower part of the drawing, shows the front of the bottle which features a raised image of a corn cob with husks and the words "CORN FOR THE WORLD" embossed around it. The bottle has a short neck and a small, round mouth. In the upper right, a smaller view presents the back side of the same bottle, which displays a raised depiction of a monument or column with the word "BALTIMORE" embossed beneath it. In the upper left, another smaller view shows the bottle from the side, revealing its overall thickness and the corn cob motif extending around the sides. The background is a light beige color, and the outlines of the bottle are clearly defined with fine lines, while the glass is rendered in various shades of amber and brown with highlights suggesting transparency and reflectiveness.
title: Flask
